newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Village arranges A$230 mln facility.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Village arranges A$230 mln facility.

text.p: Cinema operator Village Roadshow Ltd said on Wednesday it had arranged a A$230 million facility to fund its global expansion through ANZ Investment Bank.
The company said the funds together with the group's surplus cash flow, would be used mostly to complete Village Roadshow's planned cinema developments both domestically and internationally.

"Village plans to more than double its interest in cinema screens to 660 by 2001. Eight new megaplex cinemas are planned in Victoria at sites including Doncaster, Southland, Sunshine, Coburg and Crown Casino in Melbourne," the company said.
Village plans to develop new cinema sites in Italy, France, Hungary, South America, South Korea, Taiwan, India and Hong Kong.
The company recently opened multiplex cinemas in Athens, Greece, Budapest, Hungary, Argentina and in December acquired a 50 percent interest in the Warner Bros U.K. and German cinema circuits.

"We see this new loan facility as an expression of the ANZ's continuing confidence in our development plans and in the management team that will make those plans a reality," Village chairman, Robert Kirby said in a statement.
At 2.45 p.m (345 GMT), Village Roadshow shares were steady at A$4.57.
